title: Britain didn’t drop its Apple backdoor. It cut the Americans out and tried again.
excerpt: Britain narrowed its Apple backdoor demand to UK users only after losing the fight in 2025. Apple has returned to a secret surveillance court to challenge it.
content_html:
Britain tried to force a backdoor into Apple’s encryption last year and lost. It has not given up. It has narrowed the demand, served it again, and Apple is back in a secret court to fight it.

Apple has filed a fresh challenge at the Investigatory Powers Tribunal, the closed UK court for secret-surveillance cases, the Financial Times first reported. The complaint targets a “technical capability notice,” a secret order that can force a company to strip encryption from its products. Apple confirmed the filing but, like the Home Office, cannot say more; the law forbids it. A hearing follows in September.

The fight began in early 2025. The Home Office ordered Apple to break the encryption on iCloud’s Advanced Data Protection, the setting that locks a user’s photos and backups so tightly that not even Apple can read them. That order reached beyond Britain to users worldwide, Americans included.

Rather than build the backdoor, Apple switched the feature off for UK users in February 2025.

The quieter second attempt

Then came a transatlantic row. US officials, among them Donald Trump and JD Vance, objected to a foreign government weakening an American company’s security.

Last August, Britain dropped the demand for Americans’ data. It did not drop the demand itself. It reissued the notice, aimed this time only at UK users, and that narrower order is what Apple is now challenging.

Trimming the order calms the diplomacy without solving the problem. A backdoor built for British users is still a backdoor. A lawyer at Withers put it plainly: restricting the notice to Britons may cool the US row, but it will not erase Washington’s concern about a foreign state forcing an American firm to weaken its own encryption.

And British data routinely holds Americans’ messages anyway.

The same argument, again

Apple’s line has not moved. “We have never built a backdoor or master key to any of our products or services, and we never will,” the company has said. The argument is technical, not sentimental. A door built for the government is a door that bad actors will eventually walk through too.

The Home Office frames it as balance. It “supports strong encryption,” a spokesperson said, but law enforcement must reach communications “when necessary and proportionate” to fight terrorism, serious crime and child sexual abuse. The Investigatory Powers Act, it says, carries independent judicial oversight.

The rights groups Liberty and Privacy International, both backing Apple, call the same system a regime of secret orders.

The secrecy is the fight. The government issues these notices in the dark and argues them in a closed court. Neither side may confirm the details. What is public is the pattern.

Britain wants into encrypted data. It keeps hearing the same answer: it cannot have that without breaking security for everyone. And it keeps asking in a quieter voice. It has already cost UK iPhone owners a security feature. The next ruling decides whether it costs them more.

content_html_zh:
去年，英国试图在苹果的加密系统中安装后门，但失败了。 它并没有放弃。 它缩小了需求，再次满足了需求，苹果又回到秘密法庭与之抗争。

据英国《金融时报》首先报道，苹果公司向调查权力法庭提出了新的挑战，该法庭是英国负责秘密监视案件的非公开法庭。 该投诉针对的是“技术能力通知”，这是一项可以迫使公司从其产品中取消加密的秘密命令。 苹果公司证实了该文件，但与内政部一样，无法透露更多信息。法律禁止这样做。 九月份将举行听证会。

这场战斗始于 2025 年初。 内政部命令苹果破解 iCloud 高级数据保护的加密，该设置将用户的照片和备份锁定得如此之紧，以至于苹果也无法读取它们。 该命令超越了英国，影响到了世界各地的用户，其中包括美国人。

Apple 没有构建后门，而是于 2025 年 2 月为英国用户关闭了该功能。

更安静的第二次尝试

然后是一场跨大西洋的争吵。 包括唐纳德·特朗普和 JD·万斯在内的美国官员反对外国政府削弱美国公司的安全。

去年八月，英国放弃了对美国数据的需求。 它并没有降低需求本身。 它重新发布了该通知，这次仅针对英国用户，而缩小范围的订单正是苹果现在所挑战的。

削减秩序只能安抚外交，但不能解决问题。 为英国用户构建的后门仍然是后门。 威瑟斯律师事务所的一位律师直言不讳地说：将通知限制在英国人可能会缓和美国的争端，但这不会消除华盛顿对外国迫使美国公司削弱其自身加密技术的担忧。

无论如何，英国的数据通常都包含着美国人的信息。

同样的论点，又来了

苹果的路线没有动。 该公司表示：“我们从未为我们的任何产品或服务建立后门或万能钥匙，而且永远不会。” 这个论点是技术性的，而不是情感性的。 为政府建的门最终也将是坏人走过的门。

内政部将其视为平衡。 一位发言人表示，它“支持强加密”，但执法部门必须“在必要时和适当的时候”进行通信，以打击恐怖主义、严重犯罪和儿童性虐待。 报告称，《调查权力法》具有独立的司法监督权。

支持苹果的权利组织自由组织和隐私国际组织将同一系统称为秘密命令政权。

秘密就是战斗。 政府在暗中发布这些通知，并在非公开法庭上进行辩论。 双方均无法确认细节。 公开的就是模式。

英国想要进入加密数据。 它不断听到同样的答案：如果不破坏每个人的安全，它就不可能做到这一点。 而且还一直用比较小声的声音问道。 英国 iPhone 用户已经因此失去了安全功能。 下一个裁决将决定是否让他们付出更多代价。
